utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah—it's mostly the gate and a couple lane markers, I think. I'm still a bit fuzzy on the full list, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—gate and lane markers are a good start. If you want, I can help sort out the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What do you need most right now for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’m still pulling together the rest of the details, but that’s the main update for now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know if you need any help once the details come together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know which tools we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Cleo — I’m ready when you are. Just send the list from the first repair drive stop, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — you didn’t miss much. We’re still sorting the plan, so I’m checking what needs doing and when people should show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m still planning on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — Maple community center on Saturday morning works for me. If you hear any updates, just pass them along and I’ll keep catching up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help where I can, but I need to keep things simple right now. What’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep tracking the repair drive locations and note any updates—just tell me which spot you want checked first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check what tools we’re still missing for the repair drive and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Pia — I’ll keep spreading the word and line up anyone who wants to help once you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and help connect folks who want to pitch in—just tell me the plan and when you need people there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for sure — I’m just nailing down the time and what tools we still need. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I’m still trying to remember the first repair drive spot. If you know it, could you point me there?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—it's happening. What do you need fixed, and when should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the tool list, then I can swing by and see what else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — once you have the tool list, could you send me the exact repair items too? I want to double-check the gate and lane markers before I help.
